configuration:
seed: 42
study: priority_dgr_orion
output_dir: <local path>
data:
  root: <local path>
  train_manifest: train_dataframe.csv
  val_manifest: val_dataframe.csv
  test_manifest: test_dataframe.csv
  crop_size: 256
  channels:
  - 0

  name: dgr
  in_channels: 17
  base_channels: 64
  image_size: 256
  decouple_step: 100
objective: {}
loss:
  l1: 1.0
validation:
  lpips: true
  selection: fixed_final_step
  selection_metric: lpips
  fp32: true
  unpadded: true
  selection_mode: min
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 8
    min_delta: 0.0001
    warmup_checks: 5
    warmup_steps: 10000
    warmup_epochs: 5

  max_steps: 20000
  batch_size: 1
  lr: 5.0e-05
  amp: bf16
  validate_every: 1000

  max_seconds: 12600
  discriminator_lr: 1.0e-05
